scope: Assess whether the newly documented acis-core source-free SAB authoring API can speed deterministic local ACIS controls without being misclassified as an independent parser, semantic oracle, or native producer witness.

method.kind: Primary-source published crate API, crate metadata, cq-acis release attestation/documentation, repository plan audit, and one existing generated fast test

localFastCheck.scope: Existing generated legacy modeler-DXF ASCII/binary writer/readback matrix only; it does not exercise acis-core or SAB authoring.

observed: The acis-core 0.3.8 API documents BoxSpec and SabEncoder for an experimental ASM23200MetricBox profile.
The documented box has fixed profile properties, exactly 86 active entities, input size/coordinate bounds, and topology/ownership/finite-value validation before encoding.
HistoryMode::None is intended for source geometry; a separate insertion-only history mode creates a fresh state.
A separate experimental BrepSpec authoring profile is limited to planes, cylinders, lines, circles, and ellipses, with pcurves absent and no native qualification.
doesNotEstablish: that the SabEncoder output has been accepted by AutoCAD, ODA, or a native CAD application
that its parser or its own round-trip is independent validation
that its model is valid for arbitrary ACIS versions, history, transformations, or producer conventions
evidence.planUse: Optional source-free ephemeral test-input generation at an already scheduled composed checkpoint; retain dependency-free local vectors for normal fast slices.

observed: PyPI attests cq-acis 0.3.12 to monozukuri-ai/cq-acis commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889.
cq-acis documentation describes acis-core as its shared Rust model/parser layer and CadQuery/OCCT as a separate geometry-conversion layer.
The published acis-core 0.3.8 API and the later cq-acis 0.3.12 artifact are distinct versioned artifacts; mutable main documentation was not proven identical to the attested tag in this pass.
doesNotEstablish: that acis-core 0.3.8 source and cq-acis 0.3.12 bundled source are identical
that the crate's structural validation proves B-rep validity or source-file compatibility
that cq-acis provides an independent kernel relative to FreeCAD's OCCT path
evidence.planUse: Treat acis-core/cq-acis as one project lineage; inspect the exact lockfile and tagged source before composing author and reader versions.

observed: A source-authored asymmetric box could avoid acquiring an external drawing and could avoid the CadQuery runtime if only raw generation/structural checks are needed.
Kernel metrics still require a separate converter/kernel route; native acceptance and DWG AcDs owner association remain separate gates.
The existing fast modeler-DXF matrix passes without installing or running the candidate crate.
evidence.planUse: At one composed checkpoint, use acis-core only if its exact version/toolchain is already available or explicitly approved for setup; otherwise record NOT_RUN and continue with existing locally generated vectors. Do not add it as a normal build or test dependency.

implementationReadiness.controlGeneratorCandidate: acis-core 0.3.8 BoxSpec/SabEncoder; experimental and source-generated only
implementationReadiness.ordinaryFastGate: Touched strict build + one focused generated test + relevant compatibility compile + git diff --check; no external setup
implementationReadiness.composedGate: Exact crate/source/lock pin, ephemeral asymmetric control, independent expected manifest, separate parser/kernel/native observations
